# Bundled frontend dependencies

These assets are included locally so development does not require a CDN connection.

| Library | Version | Upstream | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Bootstrap | 5.3.3 | https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap | MIT, `BOOTSTRAP-LICENSE.txt` |
| Bootstrap Icons | 1.11.3 | https://github.com/twbs/icons | MIT, `ICONS-LICENSE.txt` |
| Chart.js | 4.4.8 | https://github.com/chartjs/Chart.js | MIT, `CHARTJS-LICENSE.txt` |

Files were downloaded from jsDelivr and the upstream tagged GitHub releases. Preserve their licenses when updating or redistributing.
